kinds.description: A durable request for a named human to judge a defined question against linked evidence.

descriptions.title: A concise label for the review outcome being sought.
descriptions.progress_status: The persisted review lifecycle state, not an activity update.
descriptions.reviewer: The human expected to make the judgment; coordination metadata, not authorization.
descriptions.requested_by: The human accountable for the scope and evidence supplied.
descriptions.question: The exact judgment the reviewer is being asked to make.
descriptions.decision_summary: A concise persisted outcome recorded after the review.
descriptions.decided_at: The ISO 8601 timestamp at which the persisted decision was made.

progress_status.requested: Ready for the reviewer; no review is yet in progress.
progress_status.in_review: The reviewer is actively considering the request.
progress_status.changes_requested: Work must be addressed before another decision.
progress_status.approved: The reviewer accepted the proposal; terminal for this request.
progress_status.canceled: The requester withdrew the request; terminal for this request.

link_descriptions.reviews design: A design whose reasoning or contract is under review.
link_descriptions.reviews task: Implementation work whose scope or result informs the judgment.
link_descriptions.reviews roadmap item: The strategic commitment affected by the judgment.
